title: Your big three, on a date
caption: The Rising shows up on date one, the Sun by month three, and the Moon on the first hard day. Comment your big three.

beats.head: Your *big three* show up at different times.
Their *Rising* is the first date.
beats.sub: The vibe, the outfit, the hello.

beats.head: Virgo Rising: neat, polished, *a little* shy.
beats.sub: They notice your shoes before your jokes.

beats.head: Their *Sun* shows up by month three.
beats.sub: Who they really are once they're comfortable.

beats.head: Leo Sun: suddenly *loud,* warm and generous.
beats.sub: The shy one from date one was just warming up.

beats.head: Their *Moon* shows up on the hard day.
beats.sub: What they need when they're tired, sick or sad.

beats.head: Cancer Moon needs *home.*
beats.sub: Soup, a blanket, and you staying.

beats.head: The Align app puts all three on their *card.*
beats.sub: So you know the layers before the first hello.

beats.head: Same person. *Three* layers.
beats.sub: Fall for all of them, not just the first one.

beats.head: Comment your big three. We'll guess your *first date.*
